abstracts.text: The Project Manager will take notes and place the minutes in the shared folder (item 0).
A combined energy source using battery with kinetic back-up, and battery charging when moved, was adopted (item 1).

UI reports windows problems during the session, five-minute time pressure, and budget/cost constraints for chips and LCD components (items 11,12,13).
